description: For fixed finite labelings, a native global configuration \((q,h,t)\) represents code \(c\) when \(c\) is valid, its state and current coordinates are \(\sigma(q),\gamma(t(h))\), and every left or right indexed entry is the label of \(t(h-i-1)\) or \(t(h+i+1)\), respectively. Missing entries are blank label \(0\).
